capabilities: Build routes between waypoints via openrouteservice
Generate isochrone reachability polygons around a center point
Resolve search terms to place suggestions (POI search)
Read elevation for the points of a track
Snap recorded tracks to the road or path network
disambiguation: Not a standalone map plugin; it only supplies routing and geocoding services to the Places plugin.
extras: The plugin is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README does not document how to configure an API key or which openrouteservice endpoints are used.
problem: The Places plugin needs an external routing and geocoding service to build routes, reachability areas, and place suggestions on its maps.

relations.evidence: places-shared | Shared map, overlay, routing, and utility code

summary: Routing provider for the Places plugin that adds openrouteservice directions, isochrones, POI search, elevation, and track snapping.
